script: Chapter 8. Off-Page SEO, Link Building and Local SEO. Local ranking depends on relevance, distance, and prominence. Prominence comes from reviews, links, and consistent citations. Use your real business name, the correct category, photos, hours, and services. Ask happy customers for reviews, and reply to every review. Earn links with useful resources, PR, and partnerships. Never buy links. Recap: earned links and accurate local data.
glossary: link building, Google Business Profile, local SEO, citation, review
